limits: No Docker image/network execution or live external PostgreSQL/MySQL/MariaDB engine was run for this issue.
Packaged authorization checks use a synthetic ClamD wire/verdict fixture, not a real malware engine.
The loopback native forwarding fixture simulates a trusted TLS edge, not an external TLS handshake.
Five existing AF_UNIX integration cases remain skipped; new filesystem symlink cases ran.
Canonical grants and worker path equality are pathname checks, not inode/content snapshots or atomic remote daemon lookups.
Restricted history uses recorded canonical target metadata; concurrent updates retain ordinary pagination consistency limits.
Legacy unresolved root grants require explicit reissuance; malformed queued targets may need resubmission.
